title: Rate manipulation via stake/unstake timing
description: Users can manipulate their effective reward rate by carefully timing their stake and unstake operations around reward distribution events. While this does not directly steal funds, it allows sophisticated users to gain advantages over less informed participants, creating an uneven playing field.
impact: Grief factor for regular users who do not optimize their stake timing. Creates information asymmetry that benefits sophisticated actors at the expense of passive stakers.
attackPath: Time stake operations to maximize reward capture
Time unstake operations to minimize exposure during low-reward periods
recommendation: Implement time-weighted reward distribution to reduce the advantage of timing-based strategies. Consider using continuous reward streaming rather than discrete distribution events.
